summary: Coordinate new hire join-date sync: IAM provisioning, automated secrets rotation schedule, and staggered asset delivery
description:
Issue summary:
HR scheduled an international hire (SWE II) with an initial start date of 2026-03-01, later changed to 2026-03-08. Several downstream systems (IAM provisioning job, automatic secrets rotation window, and third-party logistics for laptop delivery) are currently still lined up for the original date.

Impact:
- Employee may not receive required SSO groups and service account access on day 1 if IAM is provisioned to the old date.
- Automated secrets rotation scheduled for 2026-03-02 would rotate service-account keys without the new owner being present to confirm access.
- Hardware shipping is booked for 2026-03-03 with remote pickup window; new date mismatch risks the laptop being delivered to a secure facility with no local contact.

Environment:
- Redwood HR Workday integration (prod), IAM automation via identity-provisioner service, KeyVault secrets-rotation job (prod), Vendor: ShipMate logistics (RFP-shipmate-2024).

Steps to reproduce / How this surfaced:
1) HR changed start date in Workday from 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-08 and left comment only in the candidate record.
2) Ayesha noticed the mismatch while preparing orientation docs and filed this ticket.
3) Observed automation logs showing identity-provisioner queued tasks for 2026-03-01, secrets-rotation scheduled between 2026-03-02 and 2026-03-04, and ShipMate pickup scheduled 2026-03-03.

Logs / links:
- Workday candidate record: confluence://hr/workday/candidates/3729 (HR-only link)
- Identity-provisioner queue: https://infra.redwood.local/queues/identity-provisioner?job=3729
- Secrets rotation runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SRE/KeyRotation+Runbook
- ShipMate shipping order: https://vendor.shipmate.com/orders/SM-7881

Investigation notes:
- Identity-provisioner uses the candidate.start_date field as the source of truth; no separate audit webhook for HR date changes currently triggers a re-sync.
- KeyVault rotation job is calendar-driven and rotates keys for newly created service accounts within 72 hours by default. If an account is created and rotated before owner access is validated, the owner could be locked out and an engineer will need to manually re-grant access.
- ShipMate's vendor portal only accepts single-date pickup windows; we previously requested a split shipment but vendor requires an explicit hold request against the order.

Proposed immediate actions / workaround:
- Pause the scheduled identity-provisioner run for job 3729 until after 2026-03-07. (Assigned to Jordan)
- Add candidate ID 3729 to KeyVault rotation hold list so automatic rotation skips service accounts associated with this hire until 2026-03-09. (SRE/Infra)
- Contact ShipMate rep to place a delivery hold and reschedule pickup for 2026-03-09 with local office contact Rajiv Mehta. (IT Ops / Hardware Shipping)

Longer term follow-ups (backlog):
- Implement an HR -> infra change webhook that triggers re-sync of identity-provisioner whenever start_date is updated. (ENG-Infra backlog)
- Add a pre-rotation validation step in KeyVault pipeline that checks for confirmed owner access before rotating recently created credentials.
- Vendor process: negotiate ShipMate hold/reschedule capability or migrate to vendor that supports holds for international hires.

Acceptance criteria for closure:
- Identity-provisioner creation task is rescheduled to 2026-03-08 with audit entries showing the change.
- KeyVault rotation hold removed after 2026-03-09 and rotation completes with owner access validated.
- ShipMate order updated with new pickup date and confirmation from Rajiv Mehta.

Related links and references:
- related_confluence_pages: ["https://confluence.redwood.com/display/HR/Onboarding+Policy","https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SRE/KeyRotation+Runbook"]
